title: Introductory Remarks by Nada Anid
session_title: Public Affairs and AIChE: A PAIC Town Hall
abstract: PAIC aims to identify, respond to, and communicate public-policy issues at local, national, and international levels. It also aids AIChE members in learning how to communicate better with government and the public. In light of this mission, the goal of the Town Hall meeting is 1) to share the findings of three PAIC Task Forces and get the members’ input on each and on other matters of importance to the AIChE membership and 2) to consider the best means of communication to enhance the standing of the AIChE community and express its stand on policy matters.

title: Food-Energy-Water Issues
session_title: Public Affairs and AIChE: A PAIC Town Hall
abstract: The overlapping needs and technologies for food, energy, and water call for contributions from many people around the world, but chemical engineers bring especially valuable expertise. This briefing will summarize the issues and preview the topical conference that is taking place this week.

title: Advanced Manufacturing
session_title: Public Affairs and AIChE: A PAIC Town Hall
abstract: New “Advanced Manufacturing” approaches are expected to impact the production of chemical products significantly. Recent advances include process intensification, manufacturing for sustainability, new sensors and actuators, data science, and high-level simulations. We will discuss what advances and further developments need to be communicated, why they should be adopted, and how they can be communicated effectively.

title: Climate-Change Review and Adaptation
session_title: Public Affairs and AIChE: A PAIC Town Hall
abstract: The PAIC is leading an AIChE review of climate change and our policy on it. AIChE members are participating in a series of online Engage discussions, each introduced by an article posted on ChEnected. By drawing from the knowledge, dedication, and passion of AIChE members, AIChE can shape a Climate-Change Policy that captures members’ concerns while helping our profession to grapple with this issue.

title: PAIC Town Hall
session_title: Public Affairs and AIChE: A PAIC Town Hall
abstract: In this Town-Hall-style, moderated discussion, the emphasis will be on identifying other critical public-policy issues where AIChE and chemical engineers can have impact. Attendees are encouraged to submit questions beforehand to the organizers by email or at the session. The goal is to shape action paths and find participants who are interested in engaging with each other and the public on these issues.
